name: Milestone timeline · tall Gantt with milestone panel (split)
purpose: Split frame: a weekly Gantt fills the tall left column from the top of the slide (phases, five workstream lanes, and a key-milestones lane whose diamonds sit on their exact weeks, staggered on two tracks). The short right column holds the title and a numbered milestone list whose M1–M8 match the diamonds, each with name, date and a short description.
